title: Köppen Climate Classification System
subject: Geography
description: A hierarchical diagram explaining the Köppen climate classification system, showing the main climate groups (A, B, C, D, E, H) and their typical sub-types based on temperature and precipitation.

graph TD

A --> C[Group B: Dry]
A --> D[Group C: Warm Temperate]
A --> E[Group D: Cold Temperate]
A --> F[Group E: Polar]
A --> G[Group H: Highland]
B --> B1[Af (Rainforest)]
B --> B2[Am (Monsoon)]
B --> B3[Aw (Savanna)]
C --> C1[BW (Desert)]
C --> C2[BS (Steppe)]

D --> D2[Cfa/Cfb (Humid Subtropical)]

F --> F2[EF (Ice Cap)]
